dse_runs.notes: Bursty Poisson bursts of 8 requests, 2 req/us avg, p99 latency <= 0.4 us. Favor pipelined families for throughput; keep data width modest to hit max_abs_err <= 2^-10 while minimising LUTs+FFs.

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **bursty_offload** was taken down the full fidelity ladder and finalized: L1 used the full 400-eval budget in a structured DSE run (refine → refine → stop), producing a 26-design feasible Pareto front dominated by pipelined_m configurations; L2 SimPy simulation of the top 5 confirmed all pass the p99 latency constraint (best simulated 0.195 µs vs the 0.4 µs bound, up from the 0.146 µs analytic bound); L3/L4 had no recorded verification/synthesis data for this design, and L5 back-annotation found no measured data to compare, so no winner change was flagged and no reexplore was needed. Final selection: `pipelined_m:data_width=15, n_iter=12, angle_guard=1, frac_guard=2, rounding=trunc, m=6` — 796 LUTs+FFs (654+141), 10.3 accuracy bits (max error 2^-10.34, within the 2^-10 limit), 68.5 MSPS throughput, 0.195 µs simulated p99 latency.
